description: 8sync safety and quality gates (secret/destructive-command guard, verify after edits, stop gate, resume note). Each hook finds the 8sync binary on PATH or at the installer's default location, is a no-op when it is not installed, and stays silent when `8sync ccc kit` already registered the same hook in settings.json. The guard fails closed if 8sync is installed but crashes.

hooks.command: B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin session-start
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin guard
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin verify
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin watchdog
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin verify-stop
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin stop-failure
B=$(command -v 8sync 2>/dev/null || ls "$HOME/.local/bin/8sync" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/8sync/8sync.exe" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$B" ] || exit 0; exec "$B" ccc hook plugin resume-note
